basic_profile.bio: I am a data scientist based in Madison, Wisconsin, with a deep passion for machine learning and AI. I graduated from the University of Wisconsin-Madison with a degree in Computer Science, and I am currently working at a tech startup focusing on AI solutions for healthcare. In my free time, I enjoy playing Mario Party and exploring new trends in blockchain technology. I am typically online during the evenings on weekdays and more sporadically over weekends. Currently, I am single and enjoy the freedom to travel and attend conferences related to my field.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in computer science with a specialization in machine learning, which I developed through coursework and practical experience during my undergrad years. I have taken advanced courses such as CS 540 and CS 532, and I am continuously expanding my knowledge through online courses and attending workshops. My expertise is further honed through my professional work where I apply machine learning models to real-world problems.
